item.title: IN NUMBERS: 2025 was fourth warmest and fourth sunniest year on record
item.description: Last year was the fourth warmest and the fourth sunniest since records began. The average temperature over 2025 was 13.3°C, which was 0.9°C above the 30-year long-term average. The Island experienced 2,382.9 hours – or just under 100 days in total – of sunshine.
